address: Armas 7, Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, 35001, Spain
bio: Located just a few steps from the Casa de Colón in the heart of the historic Vegueta district, where the city was first established, this restaurant boasts a pleasantly rustic-contemporary decor of sturdy natural stone walls and numerous decorative wood features. The cuisine embraces an array of delicious and copious dishes that are based around classic international fare enhanced by influences from countries such as Spain, France, Italy and the UK. The tartare of tuna belly with Asian flavours and wasabi and avocado sorbet came as a particularly pleasant surprise....
